title: power_curve
description: Payload of `stride power-curve`. `fit_r2` is how well the CP line fits its own 5-20 minute bests and is the query-independent way to weigh the fit: a low value means the bests are near-collinear (an athlete who never does short maximal efforts) and CP/W' are describing noise. It is 1 by construction below three points, so it is only meaningful when `fit_points` is 3.
